outOfScope: Any Core or Oracle source change; promoting or evaluating async profiles (BB-081).
Live model or paid execution; the interaction experiment itself runs in BB-095.
constraints: Conformance uses only public Core createAgentRuntime options contextRequirementBlocks/contextResolver and public Oracle exports with deterministic fixture providers and a fake model.
Async cells are executed only when BB-081 is DONE with a PROMOTE_ASYNC decision and CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 is exported; otherwise they are recorded NOT_EVALUATED, never skipped silently.
The interaction protocol is a frozen validated manifest; it defines arms and factors but runs no experiment.
Research consumes BB-093 and BB-081 as planned contracts; the Worker binds DONE BB-093 and BB-081.
Research only in this lane: no product source edits, no self-issued readiness or fabricated Jev judgment.
invariants: On every supported Core profile, Oracle requirement blocks resolve exactly once per agent call and failures stop before model dispatch.
A resumed or woken runtime never reuses a projected context block from a prior call unless it is backed by a CURRENT receipt.
Async interaction is NOT_EVALUATED unless an async profile is actually published.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Conformance suite test/oracle-core-profile-conformance.test.mjs builds a Core createAgentRuntime with contextRequirementBlocks and contextResolver = createOracleContextResolver over fixture catalog providers, and a fake model that records prompts.

D2 — Profile manifest: the suite reads docs/blackboard/work-graph.json and the BB-081 decision artifact; profiles = [CORE_SYNC] plus CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only if BB-081 is DONE and its decision is PROMOTE_ASYNC. Each unexecuted cell is emitted as {profile, status: NOT_EVALUATED, reason}.

D3 — Per-profile cases: COMPLETE resolution renders once per call; UNSATISFIED fails pre-render with zero model/capability calls; STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION fails pre-render; two sequential calls invoke the resolver twice.

D4 — Resume rule test: create a runtime snapshot with Core createRuntimeSnapshot after one call, restore into a new runtime and perform a call; assert the resolver is invoked again and no projected block from the snapshot is rendered without resolution. With BB-063 durability, a CURRENT receipt may be REUSED and a changed source yields a new resolution, never the stale receipt.

D5 — ORACLE_CORE_INTERACTION_V1 manifest scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/core-interaction-protocol.mjs: fixed factors copied from ORACLE_CONTEXT_BENCHMARK_V1, Oracle arms {O1 foundation, O2 candidate}, Core arms {CORE_SYNC, CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 when published}; design 2x2 when async is published else 1x2 with async NOT_EVALUATED; --mode validate checks structure and prints the resolved design.
D6 — If the resume test shows Core reuses projected blocks from a snapshot without re-resolution, that is a Core contradiction: stop PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than patching Core.

D7 — Evidence basis: BB-064 research fixes the async rule (KEEP_SYNC/INCONCLUSIVE leave async NOT_EVALUATED); BB-081 D11 returns PROMOTE_ASYNC, KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE or INCONCLUSIVE; Core resolves selected requirement blocks per call through contextResolver.
implementationSlices: K1 — Conformance [CI1]: implement D1-D3 for CORE_SYNC and the profile manifest logic of D2.
K2 — Resume rule [CI2]: implement D4 with and without durability, applying D6 on contradiction.
K3 — Protocol [CI3]: implement D5 and its validate test for both published and unpublished async states using fixture graph inputs.
K4 — Living truth: add docs/living/system/oracle/core-interaction.md recording evaluated and NOT_EVALUATED cells; run test:oracle, test:core and npm run verify.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: On CORE_SYNC (and CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1 only when published) Oracle blocks resolve once per call, UNSATISFIED and drift fail pre-render with zero model/capability calls, and sequential calls re-resolve.
evidenceRequired: Conformance test output per profile with call counters.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A runtime restored from createRuntimeSnapshot re-resolves context on its next call, reusing only a CURRENT durability receipt and never a stale one.
ORACLE_CORE_INTERACTION_V1 validates with 2x2 design when async is published and 1x2 with async NOT_EVALUATED otherwise, and the Living Doc records evaluated and NOT_EVALUATED cells.
evidenceRequired: Protocol validate output for both states, Core regression and repository verify logs, Living Doc diff.

livingDocs.statement: The Oracle core-interaction Living Doc records evaluated and NOT_EVALUATED Core profile cells, the once-per-call and resume rules and the frozen interaction protocol.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Specify a conformance suite resolving Oracle requirement blocks through Core createAgentRuntime on CORE_SYNC and, only when published, CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1, with fail-closed pre-render behavior per profile.
Specify the async rule: a resolution is pinned to one agent call; a wake/resume performs a new call that re-resolves or reuses only a CURRENT receipt, never a STALE one.
Specify the frozen ORACLE_CORE_INTERACTION_V1 protocol (2x2 when async is published, otherwise 1x2 with async NOT_EVALUATED) reusing ORACLE_CONTEXT_BENCHMARK_V1 fixed factors, validated offline.

sourceAnchors.match: If BB-081 keeps CORE_SYNC or is inconclusive, Oracle remains benchmarkable on the supported sync profile and async interaction is NOT_EVALUATED.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: Produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

sourceAnchors.match: async cells NOT_EVALUATED unless BB-081 publishes PROMOTE_ASYNC

negativeVerificationCases: A second resolver call within one agent call, or zero calls on a second agent call, fails conformance.
UNSATISFIED or STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION reaching the fake model (non-zero model/capability calls) fails conformance.
A restored runtime rendering a prior projected block without calling the resolver fails the resume test and triggers PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Reusing a receipt whose source changed after snapshot fails the durability resume case.
Executing async cells while BB-081 is not DONE with PROMOTE_ASYNC, or omitting a NOT_EVALUATED record, fails the protocol test.
Any edit under packages/** fails repository scope verification.
